title: The Musician Bottle and the Cap Code
lessons: The player discovers a musician-branded PRIME bottle and realizes the collaboration is part of the product launch.
The player has bought a Collector Series bottle and learns that the cap code was part of a completed collectible promotion.

text: The player discovers a musician-branded PRIME bottle and realizes the collaboration is part of the product launch.

entry-first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Limited artist bottle.

entry-first-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I noticed the artist before I noticed the flavor.

entry-first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then the collaboration did its job.

entry-first-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Does the artist change anything about the drink?

entry-first-5.speaker: PRIME
text: The drop and the bottle. Not the laws of electrolytes.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I kind of want it because it feels collectible.
Does the artist make the drink any better?
I do not buy beverages because a celebrity is on them.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: There it is. You want the bottle.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I did not say I was proud of it.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: No. The collaboration changes the reason you notice me, not the chemistry.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then judge the regular bottle. The collab is optional.
The player has bought a Collector Series bottle and learns that the cap code was part of a completed collectible promotion.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: There is a code under the cap?

entry-return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: There was. Collector Series turned the bottle into a game piece.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Past tense?

entry-return-4.speaker: PRIME
text: The promotion ended. Codes unlocked digital trophies and merch, and collecting the set connected to the bigger prize mechanic.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That is ridiculous enough that I would have played.
So the point was to make people keep buying bottles to complete a set.
I do not want hydration to become a loot hunt.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Correct attitude. If I am doing a promotion, I am doing the whole promotion.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Yes. Collecting only works if the next bottle matters.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then drink it and ignore the game. That was always allowed.
